name: Portal — BYOM models visible in playground
summary: BYOM-routed models do not appear in the Foundry portal's Models + endpoints page or the Chat / Agents Playground model picker.
description: Connections of type ApiManagement or ModelGateway register fine and their '{conn}/{deployment}' prefix works from code, but the deployments do not surface in the portal UI's model selection dropdowns. You cannot 'point and click' a BYOM model from the playground; you must invoke it through the SDK / Responses API.
notes: Status-only. Adjacent to portal-ui-parity-providers but specifically about the runtime playground/picker surface, not connection creation.
